Toggle.description: A `<button>` that is pressed or not, with `aria-pressed`. Inside a toggle group the group owns its state; inside a toolbar it is one of the toolbar's items.

props.pressed: Whether the toggle is pressed. Pass it with `onPressedChange` to control it. Ignored inside a toggle group. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over (`pressed={setting}`); one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.
props.defaultPressed: Whether the toggle is pressed at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onPressedChange: Called with the new state when the toggle is pressed. Inside a group it runs before the group's `onValueChange`. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the toggle is never held by it.
props.disabled: A disabled toggle doesn't change, and its `onClick` and `onPressedChange` aren't called. It is also disabled when its group is. A toggle disabled while it has focus takes focus back when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.
props.value: What the toggle stands for in a toggle group's `value`. Give one to every toggle in a group.

dataAttributes.data-pressed: Present while the toggle is pressed.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the toggle is disabled.
